name: Sjuhäradsleden, etapp 10: Årås säteri - Hotell Mullsjö
description: Årås säteri to Hotell Mullsjö. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
utilities: STF Årås Säteri & Trädgårdar / Årås Kvarn (lodging)
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Borås and OSM tag the section as 22 km. Naturkartan/E1 use 21.3 km or API 21.2 km. Computed Naturkartan linework is about 21.24 km, E1 is about 21.19 km and current OSM about 21.54 km.
Borås lists Medium. Description text calls it an easy stage mostly on road. The shared/connecting Södra Vätterleden stage is Blå - medel.
Borås/Naturkartan use Årås säteri to Hotell/Hotel Mullsjö. Mullsjö, OSM and E1 often use Årås kvarn and describe or publish the physical stage in reverse from Hotel Mullsjö to Årås kvarn.
OSM relation tags say from Årås kvarn to Hotel Mullsjö, but member order is Hotel-to-Årås. Geometry is topologically continuous after orienting ways.
Naturkartan and OSM endpoints agree closely, but local deviations reach about 80-103 m and OSM computes about 0.30 km longer than Naturkartan.

Mapped fire/rest sites exist near Årås, Trollsjön/Stråken and Mullsjö, but protected-area rules differ: Årås and Ryfors prohibit fires, while Stråkens strandskogar allows fires only at designated places with own firewood.

facilities.name: Årås säteri / Årås kvarn trailhead
facilities.description: Official stage start with parking and information in the Årås säteri/kvarn area. Keep route-line endpoint, parking and Årås service cluster deduplicated.

facilities.name: STF Årås Säteri & Trädgårdar / Årås Kvarn
facilities.description: Historic estate/mill lodging cluster with hostel accommodation, guest kitchen, breakfast/food context, parking and seasonal/event-oriented services. Opening, cafe and water access are seasonal/booking/customer-dependent. Do not promise walk-up availability.

facilities.name: Ryfors Golfklubb / ställplats
facilities.description: Golf-club and motorhome-service area near Ryfors with cafe/light refreshments, parking, seasonal motorhome spaces, toilets, showers, drinking water and grill according to local/service sources. Services are guest/seasonal and should not be treated as unrestricted public water/toilet access without confirmation.

facilities.name: Ryfors Smedja / Ryfors Bruk
facilities.description: Covered table/rest area and heritage context at the smithy/old Ryfors industrial setting. Import as rest/heritage, not as water or camping.

facilities.name: Ryfors reserve entrance cluster
facilities.description: Ryfors Gammelskog entrance area with gravel parking for many cars/one bus, information boards, dry toilet and trash bin. Deduplicate older/duplicate Naturkartan toilet entries such as 'Dass, Ryfors'.

facilities.name: Ryfors gammelskog / old pine forest
facilities.description: Old-growth pine/forest reserve context close to the final Södra Vätterleden overlap. Länsstyrelsen lists hiking paths, rest areas, parking and dry toilet at the reserve. Do not duplicate with individual parking/toilet/rest objects.

facilities.name: Stråkensbro
facilities.description: Historic railway bridge/footbridge and timber-loading heritage point on or near the final forest route. Heritage/view context only.

facilities.name: Stråken naturbad
facilities.description: Small beach at Stråken directly referenced by the official stage description and located on/near the route. Do not mark lake water as drinking water.

facilities.name: Mullsjö Camping
facilities.description: Commercial camping/cabin facility by Stråken with electric pitches, service house, kitchen/laundry, reception shop/kiosk and bathing/fishing context. Fee/guest access. Do not model as free wild camping or public water.

facilities.name: Hotell Mullsjö ledentré / Friluftshotellet bus
facilities.description: Major endpoint trailhead/access cluster with information, parking by the hotel and nearby bus stop Mullsjö Friluftshotellet. Do not encode schedules without live JLT timetable refresh.

facilities.name: Badplats, Mullsjö Hotell & Konferens
facilities.description: Beach by Hotell Mullsjö with sand beach, jetties, diving tower and toilet according to Naturkartan. Toilet likely seasonal; do not mark lake water as drinking water.

facilities.name: Mullsjö C / Infocenter / town services
facilities.description: Rail/bus access, Infocenter, cafés, grocery and town services in Mullsjö, reached by an orange-marked access trail from Hotell Mullsjö. Not on the main section; keep separate from endpoint facility records.
